candidates.description: This vector represents common masculine given names and personal name components.
This vector activates on fragmented subword tokens across multiple languages and abbreviations.
This vector activates on a random assortment of multilingual subwords, suffixes, and proper nouns due to residual or unaligned embedding space artifacts.
This vector activates on various sub-word tokens and characters across diverse human languages.
This vector represents multilingual subword tokens and character fragments, primarily from Hindi and other Indic scripts, used in tokenization.
This feature vector activates on tokens and subwords related to the English language, English proper nouns, and Hindi text segments.
This vector is related to proper names of individuals and historical figures.
This vector represents sub-word tokens and text fragments from Hindi script mixed with English proper nouns.
This vector is related to mixed-script software development terms and multilingual character fragments.
This vector is related to subword suffixes and character sequences common in Indic and other multilingual morphological tokens.
